description: Join LaKesha Womack for a virtual campaign launch for the Democratic nomination in North Carolina’s 14th Congressional District on Friday, December 5. She will be sharing why she's running, what’s at stake for our district, and how you can get involved as we work together for affordable health care
paid_for_by: Paid for by the Committee to Elect LaKesha Womack
title: Virtual Campaign Launch — LaKesha Womack for NC-14
